repos_data.description: MCP server for Mendeley reference manager - search, retrieve, and manage your academic library from Claude and other MCP clients
Annota — AI-Powered Paper Annotation MCP Server. Reads PDFs, highlights findings, explains formulas, writes structured notes.
MCP server for Google Scholar: search papers with Scholar operators, year ranges, cited-by and all-versions lookups, plus citations in five styles with BibTeX export. 1,000 free credits every month.
MCP server for Scholar Sidekick — resolve any scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS, WHO IRIS) into 10,000+ CSL styles or nine export formats, single or batch.
